 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Aja Kumar Singh, Adv
 For the Informant : Mr. Raj Kumar, Adv
 For the State : Mr. Raj Ballabh Singh, App
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Sourendra Pandey
 Oral Order
Heard learned Counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the informant as well as learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State.

2. The petitioner seeks regular bail in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 376 of the I.P.C.
3.

This case has been listed today in view of the previous order dated 07.10.2024, whereby the provisional Bail granted to the petitioner was extended for the next nine months starting 04.07.2024.
4.

Learned counsel for the petitioner as well as learned counsel for the informant have jointly stated that the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.58599 of 2023(11) dt.09-07-2025 petitioner as well as O.P.
No. 2 have been residing peacefully and are together for the said period and they have no complaints against each other.
5. In view of the above, the provisional bail granted to the petitioner vide order dated 04.07.2024 in connection with Phulwarisharif P.S. Case No. 767 of 2023, is hereby confirmed.
